## About
David's Auto Collision is a small, family owned and operated body shop at 3308 Ella Blvd in Houston. We handle minor and major collision repair, from small dents to major panel replacements, plus frame straightening and alignment work.
We're independently owned, and we choose not to be a direct repair shop for any insurance company. That means no insurer pushes us to use aftermarket or recycled parts. We focus on quality replacement parts, paint and customer service.
Our I-Car certified technicians keep up with ongoing training. Neighbors have given us a 5 star rating across 403 Google reviews, and we'd be glad to take a look at your car.

## Services
- Body repair and paint: A full range of body repairs, from small dents to major panel replacements, with paint matched to your factory finish.
- Frame straightening: If your frame has been damaged, we use a digital measurement system and frame machine to protect its integrity and correct the damage.
- Alignment and suspension: Suspension repairs and alignment checks so your car drives smooth and safe again.
- Free estimates: Free, quick estimates on your collision damage. Appointments are highly encouraged.

## FAQ
Q: Can you help with my insurance claim?
A: Yes. We're insurance claim specialists, and reviewers say we were great to work with on the insurance side.

Q: Do I need an appointment for an estimate?
A: Appointments for estimates are highly encouraged. Give us a call to set one up.

Q: Do you have a special for first responders and veterans?
A: Yes. Law enforcement, fire department and veterans of Houston get $100 off any job.
